content.text: {"summary":"Focus the search, prepare strong materials, and create a repeatable application rhythm.","questions":["What is your target industry or job role?","Which cities or remote options work for you?","When does your recruiting season end?","What experience should your applications emphasize?"],"steps":[{"title":"Choose two target role families","why":"A narrow target makes every later application more relevant.","doneWhen":"Two role families and ten suitable employers are listed.","sourceUrl":""},{"title":"Create a focused resume version","why":"A role-specific resume makes your strongest evidence easier to see.","doneWhen":"One resume version is ready for each role family.","sourceUrl":""},{"title":"Build an application tracker","why":"A single tracker prevents missed deadlines and follow-ups.","doneWhen":"Every target employer has a status and next date.","sourceUrl":""},{"title":"Submit the first five applications","why":"A small first batch creates useful feedback quickly.","doneWhen":"Five tailored applications are submitted and recorded.","sourceUrl":""},{"title":"Review results each week","why":"Response patterns show where to adjust positioning or targets.","doneWhen":"A weekly review and next batch are scheduled.","sourceUrl":""}]}
